question.prompt:
A prism has 21 edges in total. How many sides does its base have? (Enter a number; for example, enter 5 for a pentagonal prism.)

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_050_q4_question_en.svg)

solutions.explanation: An \(n\)-gonal prism has \(3n\) edges (\(n\) on each of the top and bottom bases, and \(n\) lateral edges). \(3n=21\), so \(n=7\). It is a heptagonal prism.
solutions.title: Count three groups of edges
